description: Land Title Settlement Department - Atorawa, Mailewe, Nallachchiya Radagana, Thambuttegama, Thammennagama, Thambuttegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110053
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the Commissioner's determination regarding title to specific land parcels (Nos. 1062, 1106 and 1136) in Anuradhapura District. The content includes detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extent, ownership details (Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority), and classification information. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
